name: Emerald Sanctuary
summary: At Felwood’s southern entrance, druids gather at Emerald Sanctuary to study the demonic taint and heal the woods.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Blight
sections.body: At Felwood’s southern edge, Emerald Sanctuary is the Cenarion Circle’s base in the blighted woods. Night elven and tauren druids work side by side here, setting aside the factional conflicts spreading across Kalimdor to restore the land. Researchers track corrupted flora and study Jaedenar, seeking a way to cleanse the poisoned soil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Emerald Sanctuary?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle established the camp to study and counter the demonic taint choking Felwood. Druids investigate corrupted plants, beasts, and water, then coordinate efforts against Shadow Council cultists deeper in the woods.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde visit the Emerald Sanctuary?
faq.answer: Yes. The Cenarion Circle is independent and neutral. It welcomes visitors from both the Alliance and the Horde who will help cleanse Felwood’s deep corruption.

faq.q: What threat concerns the druids here the most?
faq.answer: Druids fear the demonic energies that have warped the whole forest since the Third War, especially at Jaedenar. The sprawling caverns to the north shelter the Shadow Council, which spreads corruption through the woods.

angles.text: As a druid of Darnassus or Thunder Bluff, you share a mandate to heal the land that reaches beyond faction loyalties.
